title: The Contact of Tashkent
author: Zephyrine Okonkwo
blurb: Vesper Voss, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
